description: The node roster + operator-governance map for devs working in this repo. Use to answer "what nodes exist / are they live / what are their URLs", "who owns a node and what can the operator do to it", or "which parts are the node's vs the operator's". A where-to-look reference, NOT a doer — for actions use deploy-node / node-wizard-expert / promote / manage-node-envs. Triggers: "list the nodes", "node roster", "node URLs", "is <node> live", "operator's role/permissions over nodes".
